I have browsed the Natural Products Database on Drugs.com by navigating directly from the homepage.

Key details of the database:
- **Location & URL:** Found under the "For Consumers" section on Drugs.com at https://www.drugs.com/npc/ ("Natural Product Information (Consumer)").
- **Scope & Description:** Provides comprehensive consumer information on traditional and conventional uses of natural products, herbal remedies, and supplements. Entries cover recommended dosages, potential drug interactions, side effects, contraindications, and safety/efficacy ratings.
- **Organization & Content:** The database includes an A–Z alphabetical index containing 150 natural products, ranging from 5-Hydroxytryptophan, Acai, Aloe, and Ashwagandha to Turmeric, Valerian, Wild Yam, and Zinc.
